remarks: Welcome to a stunning sun-drenched loft where modern luxury meets urban convenience. This exceptional home captivates with soaring high ceilings and massive windows that bathe the space in an abundance of natural light. The first floor features a large, open living area overlooking the serene courtyard, a chic kitchen appointed with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, and a convenient half bath. Ascend to the upper level to discover a spacious bedroom suite complete with its own full bathroom and a generous walk-in closet. Beyond your front door, the building offers top-of-the-line amenities, including laundry, gym with a sauna and locker room, conference room, community lounge, and a large courtyard. Ideally situated, and just minutes from the vibrant restaurants, shops, South Norwalk, the train, and major highways. Don't miss this opportunity! Can be rented fully furnished or unfurnished.
